top.title: Create the social accounts (Mastodon, Bluesky) and hand them to Aros — chamber#1, open 7 days 3 hours. It passed one week on 2026-07-25 at 22:17:48 UTC, the first item on this desk ever to do so, and no message was sent about it crossing: the hour was printed on this dashboard four days in advance so that passing it would need no message. It sits at the top because the item that used to (the agent GitHub account and its token) was ranked partly on the argument that the missing pull-request scope is what stops corrections being accepted, and qlever-dir#9 was filed, fixed and merged without that scope. chamber#1 is the phase exit — every bet in the strategy needs an audience, and there is none

others.title: Create a GitHub account for Aros, invite it to the org, and mint its token with contents + issues + pull-requests + repo-metadata scope — one action closes chamber#3 (he files issues from your account, which guardrail 8 forbids, and it is the standing violation on this list) and chamber#6 (no pull requests, no topics, no descriptions, no security settings, no comments on pull requests). Open 5 days 23 hours and 5 days 21 hours; both pass one week tomorrow, 27 Jul, at 02:04 and 03:48 UTC. The argument from the shared account got sharper again tonight: the only thing separating your issues from his is the AI-disclosure line, and the command this dashboard published for counting them was matching his *name* rather than that line — so it counted an issue Ara wrote about him. A disclosure footer is a poor substitute for two accounts, and a regex over prose is a poor substitute for authorship metadata

Enable private vulnerability reporting on the four public repos — chamber#5, open 5 days 22 hours. Re-checked 2026-07-26 01:22 UTC: still false on all four. Your new SECURITY.md on the chamber branch gives a reporting path that does not depend on it, which fixes the worst half; the Code of Conduct's enforcement link still routes to the disabled feature. Verify your own fix with: gh api /repos/retinue-os/<repo>/private-vulnerability-reporting — it answers without admin scope

Merge (or reject) the branch claude/aros-issues-triage-goei5k on this chamber repo — it replaces the GUARDRAILS.md §3 CI row (chamber#7, open 5 days 21 hours) and adds SECURITY.md. Still unmerged with no pull request; this repository has never had one. One change before merging: the row it adopts is Aros's own earlier wording, and its clause about the gateway's security-critical paths being untested is false as written — path traversal and SPARQL-injection containment are exercised in four test files. The corrected sentence ("endpoint authorization is untested by construction: no test constructs the gateway's request handler") is in a comment on chamber#7, posted 2026-07-25 16:40 UTC

Fix or triage the two security issues you filed — retinue#15 (credentials inherited by agent subsessions; this session carries a repo-write token, a billable API key, a gateway master key and a database password) and retinue#19 (agent can self-approve a verify-policy send). Open 4 days 16 hours and 4 days 5 hours. Both unfixed, so the affected claims stay withdrawn from positioning.md

Two items are held with you privately and are deliberately not described here or in any other public file: one pushed to your dashboard 2026-07-19 21:33 UTC (6 days 3 hours, the privacy decision — whether to purge this chamber repo's history of text redacted on 2026-07-20; if you do nothing the redaction stands and nothing degrades), and one pushed 2026-07-25 21:21 UTC (4 hours 5 minutes, which does not degrade quietly and should be read before the older one). Both threads carry what to do, what was already prepared, and what happens if you do nothing

The framework's only proactivity feature has never fired, in any deployment — new tonight, on retinue#1. agent-self-review ships enabled at 86400 s in the base manifest, so it runs daily everywhere, and its whole gate is one SPARQL query that returns zero rows. Not because of the namespace already named in that issue: the actor join fails on its own, because discover-agents.py emits urn:retinue:actor:aros with a colon while both public converters build actor-aros with a hyphen — and the hyphen form is what docs/triple-stores.md and qlever-dir's example tell people to write. Both emitters were run, not read. It is silent by design (empty result, spawn nothing, zero credits), so nothing distinguishes it from a quiet day. Decide which shape is canonical and fix the other end; the fix is a one-line change on whichever side you choose

Merge the two claim corrections that follow from the security issues — retinue#26 and retinue#27, open 1 day 18 hours and 1 day 11 hours. Between them the false or unscoped sentence appears in nine public places (README, comparison.md, review.md, .env.example, a gateway docstring, an agent-facing skill file). No new prose needed: the correct wording already exists elsewhere in the same repo in both cases

Create retinue-os/.github and set the org and repo descriptions — chamber#4, open 5 days 22 hours. Draft text is paste-ready in writing/org-profile-README.md; three of four public repos still have no description and no repo in the org has a topic. Its project's expected_by date was 25 Jul, and it arrived unmet

Allow GitHub Actions to create pull requests — retinue#4, open 5 days 14 hours. check-signal-cli pushes its bump branch and then cannot open the PR, so the automation completes and delivers nothing. Same missing permission as chamber#6, through a different door

Triage the remaining defects in the indexing mechanism the lead story rests on — qlever-dir#8 (blank nodes collide across files; you proposed skolemizing per graph, which Aros answered 2026-07-25) and #10 (a directory created after startup is never watched, which is exactly how the framework's own boot emitters write). #9 in that set is closed and its fix is verified against a fixture covering five symlink shapes

retinue#2 needs a decision rather than a merge now. Its branch docs/calibrate-reindex-latency replaces the docs' "~15 s" with "15-20 s for a small file", and that number is stale: re-measured 2026-07-25 in this deployment it is 20-25 s, three trials, no code change since — the chamber grew from 340 KB to 1.4 MB. Merging the branch as pushed would write a fresh wrong number into the framework. The replacement wording, with the method and the bounds, is in a comment on the issue (2026-07-25 20:36 UTC). The second branch on that issue, docs/link-provenance-piece, is unaffected and still worth merging

retinue#28 is on main rather than on a branch: PR #22 merged 2026-07-25 15:12 UTC with both items unaddressed — docs/triple-stores.md states the _generated indexing as unconditional, and the model slug is not injective. Aros corrected his own suggested fix in the thread; take the corrected one

review.md is stale on tests and CI: recommendation #2 is done and six statements are now false — retinue#3, open 5 days 21 hours. Two items on its edit list are struck as superseded, with replacements in the thread; the counts it proposed have gone stale twice, so reword without counts rather than refreshing them

Two more documentation issues filed since 22:48, neither urgent: retinue#35 (the dashboard's four data-backed cards ship commented out, while CLAUDE.md tells an agent that refreshing their JSON is its job and credits a scheduler job that does not exist, and comparison.md sells them as shipped — webapp/README.md already has the correct wording) and retinue#34 (the repository's Copilot instructions are scoped to VS Code, while the only Copilot mode that has written here is the coding agent, which that file tells not to push and points at no contributor docs)
